title: Turn on the environment variable function to flash back
summary: The issue has repeated reproduction reports, attached diagnostic material, a language-dependent failure pattern, and discussion of related PowerToys work. The latest technical analysis is community-provided and should not be treated as a confirmed root cause, but it provides enough evidence to begin an ownership and mitigation design investigation.

status.label: Design in progress
status.detail: A detailed implementation-grade design is being prepared. No maintainer action is exposed until the design is complete and validated.

judgment.rationale: The issue has repeated reproduction reports, attached diagnostic material, a language-dependent failure pattern, and discussion of related PowerToys work. The latest technical analysis is community-provided and should not be treated as a confirmed root cause, but it provides enough evidence to begin an ownership and mitigation design investigation.
evidence: The reporter reproduces an Environment Variables window that flashes and closes on v0.101.2222.
The discussion includes fresh PowerToys bug reports and Windows Event Viewer evidence requests.
A commenter reports reliable reproduction with zh-CN, zh-TW, and ja-JP and normal behavior with en-US and ru-RU.
The discussion explicitly references related PowerToys issue #49069 and earlier issue #48547.
The latest analysis proposes a framework/window-title interaction, but maintainers have not publicly confirmed that explanation or its ownership.
judgment.recommended_action: Start a design investigation that validates the CJK-only crash evidence, determines whether the actionable mitigation belongs in PowerToys or Windows App SDK/WinUI, and assesses the existing #49069 mitigation without presuming the reported root cause.
